baccarat.title: Baccarat
baccarat.rulesGoalText: Bet on which side lands closest to 9 — Player or Banker. You're not playing a hand, you're betting on the winner. A tie returns your bet.
baccarat.rulesValuesText: Ace = 1 · 2-9 face value · 10, J, Q, K = 0. Hand total is the last digit only. Example: 7+8 = 15 → 5.
baccarat.rulesDealText: Two cards to Player, two to Banker. If either side hits 8 or 9 on the first two (a 'natural'), the hand ends right there.
baccarat.rulesDrawText: Player draws on 0-5, stands on 6-7. Banker's draw follows a standard table based on Player's third card. All automatic — you just bet.
baccarat.rulesSideBetsText: Player/Banker Pair pays 11:1. Perfect Pair (same rank AND same suit) pays 25:1. 'Big' pays 0.54:1 if 5-6 cards dealt, 'Small' pays 1.5:1 if only 4.

tour.welcomeBody: This is your private room. Tables, quick games and friends, all in one place. The tour takes 20 seconds.
tour.chipsBody: You started with {chips} chips. They are virtual only — they cannot be bought and cannot be cashed out. You win them at the table.
tour.tablesBody: Blackjack against the dealer pays 3:2. "Vs friends" is a points race where the winner takes the pot, and "Game night" runs several games on one shared scoreboard.
tour.friendsBody: Open a room, copy the link and send it. Whoever opens it joins your table — and you can talk in chat while you play.
tour.freeBody: The house card at the scratch counter is always free, and there is a daily gift. There is always a way back into the game.
tour.navBody: The side menu reaches every screen, and every scene has a "back to the room" button. You can always get home.
